lines.en: I shuffle along step by step.
My wings are folded at my sides.
Walking on the ground is awkward.
I head for that rock.
I grip the ground with my claws.
I go along with my long snout down.
My wingtips brush the grass.
Two steps, then I want to hop.
Not far. I'm nearly there.

lines.zh: 土坡太陡，我一路滑下来。
lines.en: The bank is too steep; I slide down it.
My bones are light enough to sway in wind.
I don't want to walk, but I need to.
My toes grip and release.
I head for the higher ground.
I stop on a flat stone.
My wings are half open.
I'm waiting here for a breeze.
My head keeps turning.
The view's good from here.
I close my snout, then open it.
I try not to shift.
My skin is thin.
I shake the dust from my wings.
Other birds call from below the ledge.
I scrape the stone with a claw.
This stone is warm from the sun.

lines.zh: 我把翅膀收到身子两侧。
lines.en: I fold my wings down against my sides.
I tilt my head at the grass below.

lines.zh: 你站着比我高出一大截。
lines.en: You stand a good head above me.
I'm not much of a fighter.
The membrane of my wings tears easily.
Your hand is up high; that frightens me.
Looking at my snout?
All I do is fly and hide.
One step closer and I drop off the edge.
This stone is mine.
I don't want trouble.
Walk on and I won't mind.
You have a strong scent.
I can take off any moment.
I nearly fell off.
A small tear in my wing.
I hopped away quickly.
Thin bones hurt easily.
A thin shriek, and my wings pull in.
I pull my neck down into my shoulders.

lines.zh: 一只爪子离了石头，滑了。
lines.en: One claw slips off the stone.
There are spots of blood on me.
I retreated to the stone's edge.
I haven't got airborne.
Is that food?
That's not even a mouthful.
I'm not really hungry.
Put it on the stone.
I'll come and take it.
You won't grab me, will you?
I've never caught this smell before.
I'll snatch it and go.
Keep the hand steady; don't wave it.
That's not enough.
You bumped me. I nearly fell.
I'm light. A push shifts me.
My wing touched you.

lines.zh: 我被撞得往后蹦了一步。
lines.en: The bump bounces me back a step.
We didn't quite connect.
Your sole landed on my claw.
I retreated onto the stone.
That's more force than I can take.

lines.zh: 我撑着翅膀才没栽下去。
lines.en: I prop myself on a wing to keep from falling.
Just let me by.
That's not how we pair.
Two of us are too light to stay steady.
The wings would tangle.
Don't stand there watching.
It's a little smaller than me.
We leaned once and parted.
There's a mark on the stone.
Afterwards we each fly off.
This motion is awkward.
Neither of us made a sound.
I bend and pinch it at my snout tip.
I can carry this.
There's an insect on the stone.

lines.zh: 我仰头一吞，喉咙鼓了下。
lines.en: I tip back and swallow; my throat bulges.
Too heavy. I can't lift it.
I pushed it off the stone.
Your thing dropped here.
There's no meat-smell on this.
I carried it two hops.

lines.zh: 嘴太窄，这东西卡在外面。
lines.en: My snout is too narrow; it won't go in.
You're on my stone.
I was about to fly when I saw you.
I shifted toward higher ground.
I don't plan to fight head-on.
Step back and I'll fly off.
I stretch my wing membrane wide.
You're between me and the updraft.
Corner me and I want to fly.
I only want to get airborne.
Don't come round that way.
I'm about to jump.

lines.zh: 这一带只有这一块石头。
lines.en: This is the only stone here.
Any closer and I'm gone.
I check which way the wind blows.

lines.zh: 我的头一直偏着对准你。
lines.en: My head stays tilted, aimed at you.
You've gone round the back of the stone.
I've raised my wings.

lines.zh: 你在那块地上站得太久了。
lines.en: You've stood on that patch too long.
I won't come down.
This spot is too open.
You changed position.
I call down at the ground below.
The wind comes from that side.
You haven't moved; I've noted it.
I edge slowly to the side.
Come close and I jump.
My shadow is at your feet.

lines.zh: 你抬手的动作我看得很清。
lines.en: I see your hand move clearly enough.
You haven't lowered that hand.
All I can do is peck.
A claw left a scratch.

lines.zh: 我用长嘴啄了一下你的手。
lines.en: I jab my long snout at your hand.
My wing slapped your face.
You moved back at once.
I lost my own footing too.
Strength isn't on my side.
I jumped and came down.

lines.zh: 这一下把我自己撞疼了。
lines.en: That hurt me more than you.
You still haven't left.

lines.zh: 我边打边往石头边上退。
lines.en: Fighting, I retreat toward the stone's edge.
There's grit in my mouth.
That's all the strength I have.
At this rate I'll tire.

lines.zh: 石缝里先伸出我的长嘴。
lines.en: My long snout comes out of the crevice first.
The wings opened first.
I landed on the flat stone.
The wind pushed me here.
The soil on me isn't dry yet.
I came from the laboratory.
Not much living here.
I shook the soil off my wings.
I'm unsteady on landing.

lines.zh: 我仰起头，把这片崖扫过。
lines.en: I raise my head and sweep the ledge.
I haven't swallowed what's in my mouth.
This stone gets the sun nicely.
I fold my wings slowly.
The sounds around are unfamiliar.
I stay still after landing and listen.
Something is moving below the ledge.

lines.zh: 我投下的影子只有一点。
lines.en: My shadow is only a small patch.
I tested a wingbeat.

lines.zh: 火一过，翅膀的膜就卷了。
lines.en: Fire curled the wing membrane.

lines.zh: 我从高处摔下来，翅膀弯了。
lines.en: I fell from height; a wing bent.
Water pinned my wings down.

lines.zh: 气浪把我卷起来，翻了半圈。
lines.en: The blast spins me up and over half a turn.
An arrow went through my wing.
That light left me dizzy.
I'm light; hunger makes me weak fast.

lines.zh: 雷打下来，我一下僵住了。
lines.en: Lightning struck and I froze.
There's no wind to borrow in the void.
